title: Durable HITL Approval Response (inbound / resume)
description: Signed payload the external dashboard/reviewer POSTs back to resume a paused ADK invocation. Validated and signature-verified by scripts/resume_workflow.py before it is ever used to construct a FunctionResponse. See references/durable_hitl_patterns.md §3 and §5.

ticket_id.description: Must match a ticket_id previously recorded from an outbound webhook (assets/approval_webhook_schema.json). A ticket_id not found in the pending-approvals store must be rejected, not repaired.

invocation_id.description: Must match the invocation_id stored for this ticket_id. A mismatch is rejected -- see references/durable_hitl_patterns.md §5.

function_call_id.description: Must match the function_call_id stored for this ticket_id. Echoed back as function_response.id on resume.

decision.description: The human's decision. This skill deliberately restricts to a closed enum rather than an open-ended string; encode richer outcomes (e.g. partial approval amounts) via 'response_payload' instead.

response_payload.description: Structured data accompanying the decision (e.g. {'approved_amount': 250}), merged into the FunctionResponse.response sent back to the agent.

decided_by.description: Identity of the approver (email, user ID, or system account) for audit purposes. Never inferred -- must be supplied by the authenticated dashboard session.

decided_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the decision was made.

signature.description: hex-encoded HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical JSON (sorted keys, this field excluded) of the rest of this payload, keyed by the shared webhook secret. Verified with hmac.compare_digest -- never a plain string comparison.
